text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq celebrates 25th anniversary of the nationalisation of Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC).
- Qatar denounces Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- National Assembly speaker calls on European parliaments to work for the lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- King Hussein of Jordan thanks President Saddam Hussein.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIA and AL-THAWRA)
- Editorial praises Iraq's decision to nationalise foreign oil companies 25 years ago.
- Several articles on the anniversary of the nationalisation of Iraqi oil.
-National Assembly ratifies an Iraqi-French joint project for agricultural development of arable land in northern Iraq.
- Editorial says U.S. distorting facts concerning oil-for-food deal.
- Commentary accuses U.S. of being behind the suffering of the Iraqi people.
